messages:
Maya Singh: Opened a tiny PR to add a concise troubleshooting snippet for 429 vs context-limit errors. Short goal: one curl repro, one Node backoff, and one sentence about streaming caveats. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2042

Oliver Park: Love the concise approach. Please include a warning: do not auto-retry mid-stream; restart only if request is idempotent.

Jessie Huang: Added a minimal curl burst and a Node pseudocode patch for exponential backoff + jitter. Also suggested parsing Retry-After in seconds and date formats.

Maya Singh: Thx — refined wording about Retry-After: honor it but cap to 2 minutes. Marked reviewers @Oliver Park @Jessie Huang.

docs-bot: PR 2042 created by maya  docs-lint passed.

Oliver Park: Quick nit: add a short note that 413-like responses mean trim/chunk; included an inline table suggestion.

Maya Singh: Added cram notes and merged after approvals. Will backport a 2-line blurb to /sdk/js/errors for CS.

Jessie Huang: Great — will paste the Node snippet to the SDK repo examples.
